tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included; development builds do not skip or relax certificate verification. Alongside this, the project has recorded that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph.

It says certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included. It also notes the recorded decision that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions. The verification decision is #29, which replaced the earlier "dev builds skip it" decision. I left that retired one out. The HTTPS line comes from #32.

The Bash heredoc for creating the directory and file failed to parse, so I wrote the file with the Write tool. I haven't committed anything.
